# arc sample

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:arcSample`](gmeow-arcSample.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/arcSample>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Attaches a sample to its integrating [`CharacterArc`](../classes/gmeow-CharacterArc.md) (⊑ [`gmeow:hasPart`](gmeow-hasPart.md) — samples are parts of the arc's analysis). Purely ADDITIVE to the existing [`CharacterArc`](../classes/gmeow-CharacterArc.md): [`arcType`](gmeow-arcType.md) and [`arcEvidence`](gmeow-arcEvidence.md) remain the holistic interpretive layer, and an arc with no samples stays valid. NOT functional.
